breaks.name: Amount mismatch
breaks.what: The payments ledger and the warehouse invoice disagree on the order total by at least one cent.

breaks.name: Canceled but paid
breaks.what: The order was canceled, but the payment was captured and never refunded.

breaks.name: Paid but never shipped
breaks.what: Money was captured and the order book has the order, but the warehouse has no items for it at all.

breaks.name: Late delivery
breaks.what: The customer received the order after the estimated delivery date the order book promised.

breaks.name: Shipped after the limit date
breaks.what: The parcel reached the carrier after the seller's shipping-limit date for one of its items.

breaks.name: Delivered but unpaid
breaks.what: The order was delivered, but the payments ledger has no payment for it.

breaks.name: Duplicate payment
breaks.what: The same payment sequence number appears twice on one order — the customer may have been charged twice.

breaks.name: Orphan record
breaks.what: A payment or an item references an order_id that exists in no other system.
